label.description: What the timeline calls an event of the kind, such as "paused".

tone.description: The tone the timeline and the activity draw an event of the kind in; "loop" is what the activity's loop filter keeps.

events.description: The core's event kinds, by kind, as the timeline names them.

additionalProperties.description: One fact: the events that open it, close it and join it, and how it reads.

absorb.description: The event kinds that join the fact: its open span, or the fact just before them when it is this one.

end.description: The event kinds that close it; when set the fact is a span, running until one comes, else each start is a fact of its own.

label.description: How the fact reads, over {{.actor}}, {{.duration}} (a closed span's), {{.count}} (its events), {{.sub}} (its first event's short value, such as a review's verdict) and {{.event}} (its first event's label); its first event's label when absent.

order.description: Where the fact is tried among the others, lowest first; name order breaks a tie.

running.description: How a span with no end yet reads, over the label's values but {{.duration}}; the label when absent.

start.description: The event kinds that open the fact: a core kind, a plugin's declared kind or a task verb's verb_<verb>.

subs.description: The words of the values {{.sub}} reads, by value; a value it leaves out reads as itself.

tone.description: The fact's tone; its first event's when absent.

facts.description: The facts a task's timeline folds its events into, by name; a later layer adds a fact or replaces one of the same name whole.
